facts.heading: Anxiety worsened in September
facts.content: Hannah feels anxious all the time, and this anxiety worsened in September.
facts.evidence: I think I'm just anxious all the time and it's got worse in September.

facts.heading: Hannah's teaching role
facts.content: Hannah has taught at her school for 11 years.
facts.evidence: I've taught here for 11 years

facts.heading: New leadership role in school
facts.content: Hannah was asked by the head to step up when the deputy left.
facts.evidence: the head asked me to step up when our deputy left.

facts.heading: Fear of inadequacy in role
facts.content: Hannah worries that people will notice she has no idea what she is doing.
facts.evidence: sooner or later someone will notice I have no idea what I'm doing.

facts.heading: Anxiety symptoms on Sunday evenings
facts.content: Hannah experiences chest tightness on Sunday evenings.
facts.evidence: My chest goes tight and I start rehearsing Monday's stuff meeting in my head.

facts.heading: Rehearsing meeting questions
facts.content: Hannah rehearses every possible question someone might ask during meetings.
facts.evidence: Every possible question someone might ask and what I would say

facts.heading: Fear of being seen as incapable
facts.content: Hannah fears people will think she is out of her depth or that she cannot lead.
facts.evidence: That I'm out of my depth. That they give the job to a nice year for a teacher who can't actually lead.

facts.heading: Rewriting email to governors
facts.content: Hannah rewrote the same email to the governors four times last week.
facts.evidence: Last week I rewrote the same email to the governors four times.

facts.heading: Fear of Mr. Hargraves' opinion
facts.content: Hannah was afraid Mr. Hargraves, the chair of governors, would think she was stupid.
facts.evidence: I was afraid Mr. Hargraves, the chair of governors, would think that I was stupid.

facts.heading: Feeling of inauthenticity
facts.content: Hannah feels like she is lying to Mr. Hargraves about being capable.
facts.evidence: Because I feel like I'm lying to him.

facts.heading: Feeling like an imitation
facts.content: Hannah feels like a child wearing her mother's coat.
facts.evidence: Most days I feel like a child wearing her mother's coat.

facts.heading: Mother's career as head teacher
facts.content: Hannah's mother was a head teacher for 20 years.
facts.evidence: My mum's, I suppose. She was a head teacher for 20 years.

facts.heading: Comparison to mother's success
facts.content: Hannah constantly compares her actions to what her mother would have done.
facts.evidence: Everything I do, I think, would she have done it better?

facts.heading: Mother's supportive comments
facts.content: Hannah's mother tells her she worries too much and should stop being silly.
facts.evidence: She says I've always worried too much and I should stop being silly.

facts.heading: Feeling of suppressing distress
facts.content: Hannah feels she doesn't tell her mother how bad things are because of her comments.
facts.evidence: It makes me feel like I'm making a fuss, so I don't tell her how bad it is.

facts.heading: Waking at 4 AM daily
facts.content: Hannah is awake at 4 every morning.
facts.evidence: I'm awake at 4 every morning

facts.heading: Waking up since second week of term
facts.content: Hannah has been waking like this since about the second week of term.
facts.evidence: Since about the second week of term

facts.heading: Consumes five or six cups coffee
facts.content: Hannah drinks five or six cups of coffee to get through the day.
facts.evidence: Five or six

facts.heading: Experiences physical symptoms in afternoons
facts.content: Hannah experiences a fast heart rate and shaky hands in the afternoons.
facts.evidence: My heart goes fast. My hands are a bit shaky.

facts.heading: Had to leave meeting last Thursday
facts.content: Hannah had to leave a meeting last Thursday to splash her face with water.
facts.evidence: Last Thursday, I had to leave a meeting to splash my face with water.

facts.heading: Feels exhausted by end of day
facts.content: Hannah feels exhausted by the end of every day from pretending.
facts.evidence: I am exhausted by the end of every day. Just from pretending.

facts.heading: Partner Ben's reaction to feelings
facts.content: Hannah's partner Ben says she should just enjoy it.
facts.evidence: He says I should just enjoy it.

facts.heading: Feels guilty and alone
facts.content: Hannah feels guilty and a bit alone when her partner says she should enjoy it.
facts.evidence: Guilty and a bit alone.

facts.heading: Lost friends after promotion
facts.content: Hannah no longer has close friends at school because she is now their line manager.
facts.evidence: Now I'm their line manager and it's awkward.

facts.heading: Misses children and class
facts.content: Hannah misses the children and her class.
facts.evidence: I miss them. I miss my class too.

facts.heading: Misses daily moments with children
facts.content: Hannah misses the daily moments when a child gets something for the first time.
facts.evidence: The daily bit where a child gets something for the first time.

facts.heading: Accepted promotion under pressure
facts.content: Hannah said yes to the promotion because she couldn't say no to the head.
facts.evidence: I said yes in the room because I couldn't say no to her.

facts.heading: Cried after accepting promotion
facts.content: Hannah cried after accepting the promotion.
facts.evidence: Then I went home and cried.

facts.heading: Misses time with children most
facts.content: Hannah misses the children the most.
facts.evidence: The children mostly.

facts.heading: Felt relaxed during summer holidays
facts.content: Hannah felt properly relaxed during the summer holidays while walking in the lakes.
facts.evidence: These summer holidays. We went walking in the lakes and I didn't think about school once for 10 days.

facts.heading: Felt relaxed when no expectations
facts.content: Hannah felt relaxed during the summer holidays because nobody expected anything of her.
facts.evidence: Nobody expected anything of me.

facts.heading: Couldn't eat before term started
facts.content: Hannah was unable to eat on the Sunday the week before term.
facts.evidence: I couldn't eat on the Sunday.

facts.heading: Tried evening journaling before
facts.content: Hannah tried writing down what went well each evening. She stopped doing it because she felt silly.
facts.evidence: I started writing down what went well each evening.

facts.heading: Feeling like a fraud in job
facts.content: Hannah wants to stop feeling like a fraud in her job.
facts.evidence: I would like to do the job without feeling like a fraud.

facts.heading: Goal for sending emails

facts.evidence: Sending an email once.

facts.evidence: Being able to sit on the sofa in the evening without my stomach in knots.

facts.evidence: A light fall.

facts.evidence: Not even Ben knows how about the 4am.
